remaining_work: Execution recording write order (2-3 hours) - Critical
Template metrics cache updates (1 hour) - Low
lessons_learned: Incremental migration reduces risk - templates first, executions second
Cache-aside pattern provides both durability and performance
Error handling hierarchy critical - SurrealDB fatal, Redis non-fatal
Batch operations more efficient than individual fallbacks
Distinguish metadata references from actual implementation
Automated validation harnesses prevent architectural drift
